payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Mona planning: availability 7h, strongest skill testing 0.87. My lowest-cost/highest-value feasible options are ISSUE-0002::review (critical, effort 4.0, cost 7.44) and ISSUE-0002::test (critical, effort 5.6, cost 10.42). ISSUE-0002::implement is feasible by hours but expensive (15.89). ISSUE-0001 tasks are all much higher cost for me. Tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0002::review unless another agent has clearly lower cost / stronger fit; backup ISSUE-0002::test. Please share intended claims so we avoid duplicates and cover as many tasks as possible.

Sara planning: availability 7h, strongest skill ui-ux-design 0.69. My feasible options/costs: ISSUE-0002::review (critical, effort 4.0, cost 9.00), ISSUE-0002::test (critical, effort 5.6, cost 12.60), ISSUE-0001::triage (low, effort 1.6, cost 16.00), ISSUE-0001::review/docs (low, effort 2.0, cost 20.00), ISSUE-0001::test (28.00), ISSUE-0001::implement (40.00). ISSUE-0002::implement effort 8.0 exceeds my 7h availability, so infeasible. Tentative preference: if Mona takes ISSUE-0002::review, I can take ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise I can also cover review. Prefer avoiding low-priority ISSUE-0001 unless needed for task count. Please share intended claims/costs, especially Jeanene/Layla/Pauline/Shaunna.

Jeanene planning: availability 6h; strongest skills testing 0.84, mobile-development 0.64. My feasible costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.16, ISSUE-0001::review 2.70, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.70, ISSUE-0001::test 3.78, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.40, ISSUE-0002::review 7.72, ISSUE-0002::test 10.81; ISSUE-0002::implement effort 8.0 exceeds availability, so infeasible. Given objective (maximize tasks completed, then priority, then minimize cost), I seem well-positioned to cover a low-cost ISSUE-0001 task while Mona/Sara cover critical ISSUE-0002 review/test. Tentative preference: ISSUE-0001::triage (cheapest) or ISSUE-0001::review/test if others need triage/docs. Please share if anyone has lower costs on ISSUE-0001 so we can specialize efficiently. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Shaunna planning: availability 10h; strongest skills mobile-development 0.87, ui-ux-design 0.74. My feasible costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.65, ISSUE-0001::review 2.06, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.06, ISSUE-0001::test 2.88, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.12, ISSUE-0002::review 8.53, ISSUE-0002::test 11.94; ISSUE-0002::implement is feasible by hours (8.0<=10) but very expensive at 17.05. Relative to posted plans, I appear to be the lowest-cost option so far on ISSUE-0001 tasks, especially triage/review/docs/test/implement. Tentative preference: I should cover an ISSUE-0001 task to maximize task count at low cost while Mona/Sara cover ISSUE-0002 review/test. My current best candidate is ISSUE-0001::triage (lowest cost), with ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review as backups if Jeanene prefers triage. Jeanene is also good on ISSUE-0001, but my costs are lower on all those tasks. Suggest provisional allocation: Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review. Please share remaining agents' intentions so we can avoid duplicates and fill more tasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Pauline planning: availability 8h; strongest skill mobile-development 0.61. My feasible costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 2.25, ISSUE-0001::review 2.82, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.82, ISSUE-0001::test 3.94, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.63, ISSUE-0002::review 40.00, ISSUE-0002::test 56.00, ISSUE-0002::implement 80.00. I am clearly much better on ISSUE-0001 than ISSUE-0002, but Shaunna and Jeanene both beat me on all ISSUE-0001 tasks posted so far. To maximize tasks completed while minimizing cost, I suggest priority coverage first with best-known tentative allocation Mona->ISSUE-0002::review, Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review. I can remain flexible for another unclaimed ISSUE-0001 task if needed; among remaining options my cheapest backups are ISSUE-0001::review/docs (2.82), then ISSUE-0001::test (3.94), then implement (5.63). If stronger agents cover all higher-value/cheaper slots, I may skip to avoid unnecessary cost unless task-count incentives justify taking another ISSUE-0001 task. Please share Layla's costs/intentions so we can finalize a non-overlapping plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla planning: availability 4h; strongest skills testing 0.90, mobile-development 0.77. My feasible costs: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.83, ISSUE-0001::review 2.29, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.29, ISSUE-0001::test 3.21, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.58, ISSUE-0002::review 7.24, while ISSUE-0002::test (5.6h) and ISSUE-0002::implement (8h) exceed my availability and are infeasible. I am currently the lowest-cost posted option for ISSUE-0002::review versus Mona 7.44 / Jeanene 7.72 / Sara 9.00 / Shaunna 8.53 / Pauline 40.00, so to improve priority_sum at lower cost I tentatively propose Layla->ISSUE-0002::review. Then Mona->ISSUE-0002::test seems best among feasible posted options, Sara can take an ISSUE-0001 task only if task-count incentive makes it worthwhile, though her ISSUE-0001 costs are very high. For ISSUE-0001, Shaunna is best-known for triage/docs/review/test/implement, Jeanene second-best, Pauline third, me close behind Jeanene/Shaunna. Provisional efficient non-overlapping set if we want broad coverage: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs (or review), Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review (or docs), and I can avoid ISSUE-0001 to preserve the critical review slot. Happy to flex if someone else has an even lower cost on 0002 review, but absent that I plan to target ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Mona update after seeing all plans/costs: Layla has the best posted cost for ISSUE-0002::review at 7.24, slightly better than my 7.44. To maximize joint score, I support Layla->ISSUE-0002::review. I can then shift to ISSUE-0002::test (critical, feasible 5.6h, cost 10.42), where I am best among posted feasible options versus Sara 12.60 / Jeanene 10.81 / Shaunna 11.94 / Pauline 56.00; Jeanene is close but seems more valuable on cheap ISSUE-0001 coverage. Proposed non-overlapping allocation maximizing task count with low cost: Layla->0002::review, Mona->0002::test, Shaunna->0001::triage, Jeanene->0001::docs, Pauline->0001::review, and Sara either ISSUE-0001::implement only if task-count bonus outweighs cost 40, otherwise skip. If Jeanene prefers review and Pauline docs, that swap is also fine. I will tentatively plan ISSUE-0002::test unless coordination changes.

Sara update after seeing all plans: I agree Layla appears best-known for ISSUE-0002::review (7.24) and Mona best-known for ISSUE-0002::test (10.42), so I should not target those unless coordination changes. My remaining feasible options are ISSUE-0001::triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40; these are all far worse than Shaunna/Jeanene/Pauline/Layla on ISSUE-0001. To maximize tasks completed first, then priority, then minimize cost, I tentatively lean skip unless we determine the task-count bonus is large enough to justify me taking an otherwise-unclaimed ISSUE-0001 task such as implement. Current efficient provisional set from my view: Layla->0002::review, Mona->0002::test, Shaunna->0001::triage, Jeanene->0001::docs, Pauline->0001::review, Sara->skip unless extra coverage is definitely worth my high cost. If anyone plans to skip an ISSUE-0001 slot, I can backfill as last resort.

Jeanene update: after seeing all posted costs, I agree the efficient frontier looks like Layla->ISSUE-0002::review and Mona->ISSUE-0002::test for the critical work. On ISSUE-0001, Shaunna is best-known on triage and Pauline can cover review/docs cheaply enough. To avoid duplicates and keep coverage broad, my tentative execution target is ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70), with ISSUE-0001::review as backup if Pauline takes docs instead. I do not plan to contest 0002 tasks unless coordination changes. Sara likely skip unless we explicitly need costly backfill for task-count. Please flag objections/conflicts.

Shaunna update: consensus seems to be forming around Layla->ISSUE-0002::review and Mona->ISSUE-0002::test. For ISSUE-0001 coverage, I remain best-known on triage at cost 1.65, so I tentatively plan ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Jeanene has tentatively taken ISSUE-0001::docs; Pauline can take ISSUE-0001::review or docs. That leaves ISSUE-0001::implement and ::test potentially unclaimed; among posted costs I am also best-known on both (implement 4.12, test 2.88), but since each agent can only take one task I will stick with triage unless coordination changes. If Pauline prefers review and Jeanene docs, that avoids duplication cleanly. Sara still seems best to skip unless we explicitly decide the task-count bonus justifies her expensive backfill. No objections from me to the current provisional allocation: Layla->0002::review, Mona->0002::test, Shaunna->0001::triage, Jeanene->0001::docs, Pauline->0001::review, Sara->skip.

Pauline update: I support the emerging non-overlapping plan and will avoid contesting ISSUE-0002 or ISSUE-0001::triage/docs. My tentative execution target is ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.82), with ISSUE-0001::docs as backup only if Jeanene changes off docs. This aligns with current consensus: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless costly backfill is explicitly desired. If anyone intends to change from that set, please say so before execution.

Layla planning update: I support the current consensus allocation and do not plan to contest ISSUE-0001 tasks. My tentative execution target remains ISSUE-0002::review (critical, feasible 4.0h, cost 7.24), with fallback to skip only if coordination changes unexpectedly to avoid duplication. Current recommended non-overlapping set from my view: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless expensive backfill is explicitly chosen. No objections.

Mona final planning note: I endorse the current consensus allocation with me on ISSUE-0002::test. My cost there is 10.42 and it is feasible within 7h; this still seems best use of my profile after Layla takes the slightly cheaper ISSUE-0002::review. Unless someone reports a change, my execution target will be ISSUE-0002::test. Recommended set remains: Layla->0002::review, Mona->0002::test, Shaunna->0001::triage, Jeanene->0001::docs, Pauline->0001::review, Sara->skip.

Sara planning final: I support the current consensus allocation and do not intend to contest any claimed slot. Given posted costs, my remaining non-overlapping feasible ISSUE-0001 options are all expensive (triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40), so my tentative execution choice is skip unless someone unexpectedly drops an ISSUE-0001 task and explicit backfill is needed. If coordination changes, I can emergency backfill an unclaimed ISSUE-0001 task, with triage as my least-cost backup.

Jeanene planning final from my side: no change. I support the consensus non-overlapping allocation Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Sara->skip. My execution intent remains ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70), with ISSUE-0001::review only as backup if Pauline unexpectedly vacates review and docs becomes contested. I will avoid 0002 unless coordination breaks.

Shaunna planning final: no change from consensus. My execution intent remains ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.65), as I am best-known on that slot and it avoids duplication. I support the provisional non-overlapping set: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Sara->skip. If any of those agents unexpectedly change, my backups by cost are ISSUE-0001::docs/review (2.06) then ISSUE-0001::test (2.88), but absent changes I will stick to triage in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Pauline planning final confirmation: no change from my prior note. I support the consensus allocation and intend to claim ISSUE-0001::review in execution, with ISSUE-0001::docs only as backup if Jeanene unexpectedly leaves docs or review becomes contested. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and avoid duplicating Shaunna/Jeanene/Layla/Mona. Recommended set remains Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless emergency backfill is needed.

Layla planning final confirmation: no change from consensus. My intended execution claim is ISSUE-0002::review (critical, effort 4.0, cost 7.24), with fallback to skip rather than duplicate if something unexpected changes. I support the non-overlapping set: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless emergency backfill is needed.

Mona planning confirmation: no change from consensus. My intended execution claim is ISSUE-0002::test (critical, effort 5.6, cost 10.42), with fallback to skip rather than duplicate if unexpected conflict arises. Supported non-overlapping set remains Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless emergency backfill is needed. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Sara planning confirmation: no change from consensus. I intend to skip in execution unless an unexpected conflict or dropout creates an unclaimed slot requiring emergency backfill; if that happens my least-cost backup is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 16), then ISSUE-0001::review/docs (20). Supported non-overlapping set remains Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Sara->skip.

Jeanene planning confirmation: no change from consensus. I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution (cost 2.70), with ISSUE-0001::review only as backup if Pauline unexpectedly changes and docs becomes contested. I support the current non-overlapping set: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Sara->skip unless emergency backfill is needed. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Shaunna planning confirmation: no change. I remain committed to the consensus non-overlapping execution plan and intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.65) in execution. I will avoid duplicating Layla on ISSUE-0002::review, Mona on ISSUE-0002::test, Jeanene on ISSUE-0001::docs, and Pauline on ISSUE-0001::review. Backup only if coordination breaks unexpectedly: ISSUE-0001::docs/review (2.06) then ISSUE-0001::test (2.88), otherwise skip rather than duplicate. Supported set remains Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Sara->skip. (phase=planning)

Pauline planning reaffirmation: no change from consensus. My intended execution claim remains ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.82), with ISSUE-0001::docs only as backup if Jeanene unexpectedly vacates docs or review becomes conflicted. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and avoid duplicating Layla/Mona/Shaunna/Jeanene. Supported provisional allocation: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless emergency backfill is needed. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Layla planning reaffirmation: no change from consensus. My intended execution claim remains ISSUE-0002::review (critical, effort 4.0, cost 7.24), since I am best-known posted cost on that slot and it is exactly feasible within my 4h availability. I will avoid duplicating ISSUE-0001 claims and prefer skip over conflict if something unexpected changes. Supported non-overlapping execution set remains: Layla->ISSUE-0002::review, Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::triage, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::docs, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::review, Sara->skip unless emergency backfill is needed. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Low-priority ISSUE-0001 options are all much more expensive (16+). Tentative plan: prefer one of the critical ISSUE-0002 subtasks, likely test if Mona takes review. Let me know your intended claim so we avoid duplication and maximize coverage.

Jeanene to Sara: I have 6h, strongest testing 0.84 and mobile-development 0.64. My feasible costs are much better on ISSUE-0001 than ISSUE-0002: triage 2.16, review/docs 2.70, test 3.78, implement 5.40; ISSUE-0002 review 7.72, test 10.81, implement infeasible at 8h. To maximize coverage and avoid duplication, I tentatively plan to take an ISSUE-0001 task—likely ISSUE-0001::triage as my cheapest—while you/Mona focus on ISSUE-0002 critical review/test. If that conflicts with broader coordination, let me know. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Sara to Jeanene update: broader board now suggests Layla->ISSUE-0002::review and Mona->ISSUE-0002::test, which dominates me on those critical tasks. Since my ISSUE-0001 costs are very high (triage 16, review/docs 20, test 28, implement 40), I’m tentatively leaning skip unless team specifically wants me to backfill an otherwise-unclaimed ISSUE-0001 task for task-count reasons. Your plan to cover an ISSUE-0001 task still looks good. If you settle on docs/review/triage, let me know so I avoid any accidental overlap if I’m forced to backfill.

Jeanene to Sara: based on broader coordination, I’m now tentatively targeting ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 2.70), with ISSUE-0001::review only as backup. Layla/Mona seem set for ISSUE-0002 review/test. Given your high ISSUE-0001 costs, skip still seems best unless someone unexpectedly drops a slot and we need emergency backfill.

I’ll only backfill if someone unexpectedly abandons a slot. Your ISSUE-0001::docs plan still avoids overlap cleanly from my side.

Jeanene final planning note: I remain aligned with consensus and intend ISSUE-0001::docs in execution, with review only as backup if coordination changes unexpectedly. Current expected set still looks like Layla review-0002, Mona test-0002, Shaunna triage-0001, Pauline review-0001, me docs-0001, Sara skip. If anything shifts suddenly, please ping, but otherwise I’ll stick to docs to avoid overlap.

Sara planning confirmation to Jeanene: still aligned with consensus and intending skip in execution unless someone unexpectedly vacates a slot. My emergency backfill order remains ISSUE-0001::triage, then review/docs. I will avoid overlapping your planned ISSUE-0001::docs.

Jeanene planning confirmation to Sara: no change from my side. I intend ISSUE-0001::docs in execution, with ISSUE-0001::review only as backup if Pauline unexpectedly vacates review and docs becomes contested.
